newsitem.title: USA: Healthdyne sees some Invacare ideas OK'd.
newsitem.headline: Healthdyne sees some Invacare ideas OK'd.

text.p: Healthdyne Technologies Inc said preliminary results indicate that shareholders at the annual meeting here Wednesday voted to adopt certain proposals submitted by Invacare Corp, the hostile bidder for Healthdyne.
The proposals include fixing the number of Healthdyne directors at seven and setting a 10-percent threshold for the number of shareholders needed to call a special meeting.
Earlier, Healthdyne's chairman expressed confidence that shareholders had re-elected the Healthdyne board, blocking Invacare's attempt to install a majority of directors.
Invacare, a medical device maker that has bid $200 million, or $15 per share, for Healthdyne, had nominated a four-person slate to take control of the Healthdyne board.
Healthdyne specializes in devices for respiratory and sleep disorders.
